static_traits.name: Zhang Yuan
static_traits.social_status: Has friends and family to confide in, but has not yet communicated this specific issue with them
static_traits.medical_history: Asthma, occasionally using an inhaler; no other significant medical history
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, high cooperativeness, sincere tone; able to notice automatic thoughts but prone to anxiety and catastrophizing; tending to avoid expression in interactions involving the liked colleague

basic_info.main_problem: Pressure and anxiety arising from a crush on a colleague; worrying about being rejected because of gaming hobby and asthma, causing obvious distress.
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling, because anxiety and pressure related to this crush have affected my work efficiency and caused emotional turmoil.

core_beliefs: I will be rejected because of my asthma and gaming hobby
I seem not serious enough and vulnerable, thus not worthy of being liked

special_situations.event: Scenes of interacting with that colleague at work or social activities
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If she knows about my asthma and gaming hobby, she will definitely not date me
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Conceals personal interests and health status, avoids expressing affection

special_situations.event: In social settings, sees her interacting with others and worries about others' views of own hobbies and asthma
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I mention gaming or asthma, she will think I am not serious enough or unreliable
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Stays silent; avoids discussing related topics
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: She will think I am not serious enough

special_situations.event: Moments requiring direct communication with her or expressing affection
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I express myself, I will say the wrong thing and the scene will be awful

special_situations.event: Repeatedly imagines in one's mind how she will evaluate me after knowing I have asthma
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: My asthma will make her see me as a burden; the problems are all in me
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: My asthma will become her burden

core_conflict.wish: Yearns to be liked and build deeper connections
core_conflict.fear: Fears being judged and rejected because of asthma and interests
defense_goal: Reducing the risk of being rejected through repression and avoiding expression, maintaining surface safety

object_relations.self_representation: A not-good-enough pursuer who might be rejected
object_relations.object_representation: Colleagues who judge and reject oneself

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When needing to communicate with a liked colleague or express affection, or thinking that she might know about his asthma and gaming hobby
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Imagining the other as someone who will judge and reject (transference: projecting inner self-doubt onto the other's intentions)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Expressing in a cautious, indirect tone, using hypothetical and conditional wording as much as possible, avoiding direct expression of emotions and needs; if pressed, shifting the topic on the grounds of 'not ready yet' and 'worrying about affecting work'.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When advised to try proactive communication and expression
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Magnifies potential risks, believing that once expressed, bad consequences will occur
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Emphasizing external reasons like busy work and unsuitable occasions, postponing action in a gentle but avoidant way.

manifestations: Fearing being rejected, making it hard to build deeper relationships
When interacting with a liked colleague, avoids expressing oneself due to worry about evaluation

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'. Language manifestations include: 'He is looking down on me', 'They want to exclude me', and so on
manifestations: Speculating that the colleague will think oneself not serious enough or view asthma as a burden
Presupposing the other's negative views before seeking evidence (mind reading)

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Worries excessively about 'saying the wrong thing', over-scrutinizes one's own expression and interests
Repressing genuine needs in interactions due to harsh self-criticism

positive_force: Possessing some self-awareness, able to identify the presence of anxiety and automatic thoughts
Willing to seek help and holding a positive attitude toward change
Has a potential support network of friends and family
negative_force: Strong fear of being rejected and sensitivity to external evaluation
Tends toward mind reading and predicting the worst outcome (jumping to conclusions)
Self-labeling and self-deprecation (viewing asthma and the gaming hobby as flaws)
Avoids expression and contact, making the relationship hard to advance

target_behavior.behavior: Significant anxiety before and after interacting with the liked colleague, and avoiding communication and expression
antecedent: Needs to interact with that colleague at work or social occasions
Thinks she may know about his asthma and gaming hobby
target_behavior.core_reason: Catastrophizing being rejected and mind-reading assumptions, believing that once understood, one will be judged and rejected
target_behavior.function: Escapes possible negative evaluation and rejection, to maintain short-term emotional safety
target_behavior.consequence: Decreased work focus and efficiency, affected sleep, inability to advance the relationship and build deeper connections
